svg.title: Differential drive using the Pololu Zumo 32U4 OLED
svg.desc: Robot photograph © Pololu Corporation — pololu.com. Differential-drive instructional graphic using the original Pololu Zumo 32U4 OLED top-view JPEG, embedded byte-for-byte without cropping, resampling, recompression, or redrawing. Vector overlays show independent left and right drive speeds and summarize steering behavior.

g.text: Differential drive uses independent left and right track speeds
Changing the relative speeds lets the robot drive straight, turn, pivot, or spin in place.
